description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing network devices, including CRUD operations and a ping function to check device reachability. It uses Flask with Flask-Smorest, interacts with a MongoDB database, and includes utility functions for device ID handling, timestamp management, and network reachability checks.

classes.name: DevicesList
classes.description: Handles listing and creating devices via GET and POST requests.

classes.name: DeviceItem
classes.description: Handles retrieving, updating, and deleting a specific device by ID.

classes.name: DevicePing
classes.description: Performs a reachability check (ping) on a device and updates its status.

methods.name: _objid
methods.description: Converts a string ID to a MongoDB ObjectId, aborting with 404 if invalid.

methods.name: _timestamps_for_create
methods.description: Generates timestamp fields for device creation.

methods.name: _timestamp_for_update
methods.description: Generates timestamp field for device update.

methods.name: _safe_ping
methods.description: Performs a network reachability check on an IP address or hostname, returning status and last checked time.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new device, enforcing unique IP address.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a ping on a device, updating its status and last checked time.
